name: comp-44

frames.best_why: All four digits are filled and the active ring sits on the last slot, showing the completed group.

tagline: Four connected digit boxes that fill up one number at a time.
summary: A row of four connected single-digit slots with a shared border. The slot waiting for input carries a pale ring, and typing advances the focus until all four digits are filled.
appearance: A small label sits above four connected square slots sharing their borders, with rounded ends on the group. Each filled slot holds one white number, the waiting slot carries a pale ring, and a grey credit line runs below.
behaviour: Typing moves the pale ring from slot to slot and drops one digit into each box, and backspace steps it the other way. The clip enters 4, 8, 2 and 9 until the group is full and the ring rests on the final slot.
demo_content: Label OTP input single with the digits 4 8 2 9 and a Built with Input OTP line.
search_phrases: type a code digit by digit
use_when: Collecting a short one-time code where splitting it into digits makes entry easier to follow.
avoid_when: The component ships a visible third-party credit link that would need removing before production.
customise: The four-digit length, label and credit line are fixed in the file; slot size, ring colour and border styling are classes there.
weight_why: One hidden input backed by four small slots; nothing animates or loops.

a11y.note: The label is bound and the code field takes keyboard input, but the visible slots are plain divs with no per-slot description.

issues: The on-screen label says OTP input single while the row actually holds four grouped slots.
A visible Built with Input OTP credit link ships inside the component.
polish_why: Clean connected slots and a clear active ring, but the label and credit link feel unfinished.
title: OTP Input Grouped
